parsePatterns.flashcards: Numbered format: **N. Question** followed by answer text with optional [SRC:...] reference
parsePatterns.questions: Single unified per-question template across all 3 banks: `### Q<3-digit id> — <Title>` header; `*Bank: bank1|bank2|bank3 · Domain: <CODE>[ (inferred)] · Difficulty: Easy|Medium|Hard|Unknown*` subheader; optional blockquote scenario (`> ...`, omitted if none); bold question prompt; 3 or 4 lettered bold options (`- **A.** ...` through `- **C.**`/`- **D.**`, Bank 3 has only 3 options); `**Answer:** <Letter>`; optional `**Confidence:** <Certain|Derived|Judgment>` (Bank 3 only, omitted for Bank 1/2); explanation paragraph (verbatim rationale or supporting quote); optional `**Source:** <fact-IDs and/or URL and/or citation code>` (omitted if the bank has no per-question source data). IDs are renumbered continuously Q001-Q427 in bank order (Bank 1 original order, then Bank 2 original order, then Bank 3 original order); original per-bank numbering is not preserved.
